classification.difficultyReason: Identify endpoints and quartiles in ordered data, averaging middle pairs where needed, then substitute into the supplied IQR calculation; marked quartile positions provide additional scaffolding.

content.prompt: Calculate the five-number summary and IQR of the data set.

spec.description: Seven ordered values with upward arrows beneath 12 and the second 13, labelled Q₂ and Q₃ respectively. Ordinary labels and arrows use house black.
spec.mathematics: 7, 8, 10, 12, 13, 13, 14; Q₂ is the fourth value and Q₃ is the sixth value.
spec.answerVisibility: The dataset and supplied quartile arrows remain visible in the student edition.

answer.worked:
Excluding the median $12$, the lower half is $7,8,10$ and the upper half is $13,13,14$.
$$\begin{aligned}Q_1&=8\\Q_2&=12\\Q_3&=13\\\mathrm{IQR}&=Q_3-Q_1\\\mathrm{IQR}&=13-8\\\mathrm{IQR}&=5\end{aligned}$$
Min $=7$, max $=14$.

spec.description: Nine ordered values with a Q₁ arrow between 44 and 45 and a Q₂ arrow beneath 53. Ordinary labels and arrows use house black.
spec.mathematics: 42, 44, 45, 48, 53, 61, 64, 68, 71; supplied arrows identify the lower-half midpoint and overall median.
spec.answerVisibility: The dataset and supplied quartile arrows remain visible in the student edition.

answer.worked:
Excluding the median $53$, the lower half is $42,44,45,48$ and the upper half is $61,64,68,71$.
$$\begin{aligned}Q_1&=\frac{44+45}{2}=44.5\\Q_2&=53\\Q_3&=\frac{64+68}{2}=66\\\mathrm{IQR}&=Q_3-Q_1\\\mathrm{IQR}&=66-44.5\\\mathrm{IQR}&=21.5\end{aligned}$$
Min $=42$, max $=71$.

spec.description: Six ordered values with an upward Q₂ arrow between 20 and 22. Ordinary labels and arrows use house black.
spec.mathematics: 17, 19, 20, 22, 24, 26; the median lies between the third and fourth values.
spec.answerVisibility: The dataset and supplied median arrow remain visible in the student edition.

answer.worked:
The lower half is $17,19,20$ and the upper half is $22,24,26$.
$$\begin{aligned}Q_1&=19\\Q_2&=\frac{20+22}{2}=21\\Q_3&=24\\\mathrm{IQR}&=Q_3-Q_1\\\mathrm{IQR}&=24-19\\\mathrm{IQR}&=5\end{aligned}$$
Min $=17$, max $=26$.

spec.description: Eight ordered values with Q₁ between the second 4 and 5 and Q₂ between 6 and 7. Ordinary labels and arrows use house black.
spec.answerVisibility: The dataset and supplied quartile arrows remain visible in the student edition.

answer.worked:
The lower half is $4,4,5,6$ and the upper half is $7,8,10,12$.
$$\begin{aligned}Q_1&=\frac{4+5}{2}=4.5\\Q_2&=\frac{6+7}{2}=6.5\\Q_3&=\frac{8+10}{2}=9\\\mathrm{IQR}&=Q_3-Q_1\\\mathrm{IQR}&=9-4.5\\\mathrm{IQR}&=4.5\end{aligned}$$
Min $=4$, max $=12$.
